objective_pt: Talk about abstract ideas such as freedom, success and happiness: define a concept, use abstract nouns accurately (without "the" for general ideas) and develop an argument beyond personal examples.

teacher.goal_pt: Get the learner to define an abstract concept in their own words.
prompts: What does success mean to you?
Is it the same as happiness?
watchFor: "The success is..." / "The happiness is...": general abstract nouns take no article.
Only giving personal anecdotes, never generalising.

exercises.prompt: Happiness isn't the same thing as success.
accepted: Happiness isn't the same thing as success
Happiness is not the same thing as success
Happiness isn't the same as success

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Abstract nouns used in a general sense take no article: "Happiness is...", not "The happiness is...".
commonErrors.correction_en: Happiness isn't the same thing as success.

options: The freedom is the most important value.
Freedom is the most important value.
A freedom is the most important value.
exercises.explanation_pt: In Portuguese we say "a liberdade", but in English a general abstract idea takes no article: "Freedom is...".

exercises.example_en: The notion of a job for life is disappearing.
In the end, it all boils down to trust.

teacher.goal_pt: Word stress in long abstract nouns and adjectives (-ity, -ive, -ical).
prompts: Where is the stress in "-ity" words?

Pronouncing every vowel fully instead of reducing unstressed ones to schwa.

teacher.goal_pt: Follow an abstract argument and identify the speaker's stance.
prompts: What is the speaker's view of freedom?
watchFor: Losing the thread when there are no concrete examples.
Answering with a story instead of an idea.

exercises.instruction_pt: Listen. What is the speaker's main idea?

options: More choice always makes people happier.
